notes: Pre repeats the prologue's s_wakeup (word 1). Body: s_sleep 1; s_wakeup; v_add_nc_u32 v4, 1, v4; s_wakeup. s_sleep/s_wakeup only affect scheduling.
Run() sets Input[tid*4] = tid*0x01010101 + 7 (no overflow for tid < 64); Check() expects input + 1. The only column is asserted.
64 rows = 2 wave32 in one workgroup as in the test; s_wakeup targets the other waves of the workgroup.
